subject: Temporary sprint stipend (10-day) to preserve pilot during PO approval
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>

Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Temporary sprint stipend (10-day) to preserve pilot during PO approval

Hi Sara —

Quick note following our call this morning. I understand procurement is routing Novamed’s PO and the finance approval window could push past the pilot end date. To avoid losing momentum on the integration proof-of-concept, Redwood can provision a one-time, account-level sprint stipend to keep the sandbox live for 10 days while your PO clears.

Proposal: 10-day stipend equivalent to $750 (redeemable as platform credits / token top-up) applied to Novamed’s pilot environment. No additional charge or invoice; one-time credit.

If that works, reply with a short approval and I’ll coordinate the credit issuance immediately. I’ve attached a one-page usage summary so you can show the cost-to-date to procurement.

Thanks —
Mateo Alvarez
Business Development Manager, Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Attachment: pilot-usage-summary.pdf (PDF, 120 KB)

Subject: Re: Temporary sprint stipend (10-day) to preserve pilot during PO approval

Matt —

Thanks for the quick follow-up. Procurement confirmed the PO is in review but it might not be finalized for another 9–12 business days; legal asked for additional clarifications which slowed routing.

The stipend sounds helpful. Can you confirm: 1) exact credit amount and how it shows on our billing page, 2) whether we need to sign any paperwork, and 3) if the credit can be applied retroactively to keep the current environment and tokens stable?

I’ll escalate internally but we need these details to justify to finance.

—Sara
Sara Lin
Sr. Product Manager, Novamed Health
sara.lin@novamed.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0182

Date: Mon, 27 Jul 2026 10:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Temporary sprint stipend (10-day) to preserve pilot during PO approval

Sara —

Thanks. Answers inline: 1) Amount: $750 one-time credit (we’ll create a credit note that appears on your account billing activity as "Promotional pilot credit — Jul 2026"). 2) No additional contract — this is a conditional promotional credit tied to the active pilot account and the Novamed deal (NOV-2026-8392). 3) Yes, we can apply it immediately to preserve the current sandbox and token balance; it will not be refundable and will expire after the 10-day window if unused.

If you confirm (simple approval from procurement/product is fine), I’ll ask Finance to issue the credit by EOD and notify you when it posts.

Best —
Mateo
